newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Airways plans 250 mln shr float.
newsitem.headline: Thai Airways plans 250 mln shr float.

text.p: Thai Airways International Plc said on Thursday it plans to offer to the public 250 million shares in late 1997.
Thai Airways chairman Mahidol Chantrangkun told reporters the share offer, at a price to be fixed later, would trim the government stake in the carrier to 76 percent from a current 93 percent.
Mahihol said of the shares being floated, 150 million would come from those now held by the finance ministry and the remaining 100 million shares would be newly issued shares.
He said the airline also has a tentative plan to float another 500 million shares during 1999-2000 which would eventually reduce government ownership in the company to about 47 percent.
Thai Airways chairman said the planned share float late this year will help finance his company's 20 billion baht ($689 million) expansion in the next few years.
Mahidol said foreign investors would be allowed to hold up to 25 percent of Thai Airways equity.
Thai Airways closed Thursday up two baht at 61.00. The stock has rarely rallied above its 60.00 baht initial offer price made when the carrier first went public in the early 1990s.
